description: ADO-EVENT, RecordsetEvents on navigation: a sink on a Recordset connected before Open; Open of K as server keyset; MoveNext, MovePrevious, MoveLast, MoveFirst, Move(3), Move(100) past the end, MoveNext at EOF (an error), Requery (no argument), Close. Each call's events (WillMove, MoveComplete, EndOfRecordset, FetchProgress, FetchComplete, WillChangeRecordset, RecordsetChangeComplete) are recorded with reasons and order. Asks the move/open/requery/close event families.
